title: The Shaukeens
desc: Bored of their mundane lives, three 60-something men, immersed in the allure of Mauritius, rekindle their youthful spirits and compete for the attention of a vivacious social media addict, Ahana.

title: Raja Ki Aayegi Baaraat
desc: Raja rapes Mala and the court orders him to marry her. His family continues to torture Mala and attempts to kill her, but she manages to win over Raja and his family with her good deeds.

title: The Stoneman Murders
desc: Mumbai of 1980s is terrorised by a serial killer who ruthlessly kills pavement dwellers in their sleep. A suspended police officer then decides to step in and conduct an investigation.
